basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old graphic designer living in a bustling city apartment. Originally from a suburban area, I recently moved to the city with my 9-year-old Shih Tzu, Max. My interests include urban gardening, budget-friendly DIY projects, and exploring investment opportunities. I dislike clutter and inefficiency, and I tend to spend my online hours in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility of managing my own schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and worked in the field for over a decade. My knowledge of dog training is mostly self-taught through online resources and personal experience with Max. I enjoy learning about new investment strategies, which I explore through subreddits such as ArkInvestorsClub.
